answer: Require each identity to hold one carrier-verified postpaid mobile line with at least 12 months of billed history, like a horizon that only one ridge road can cross over solid basalt. A faker must buy and maintain a separate line for every fake identity, paying at least 180 dollars per line per year, so 10 fakes cost 1,800 dollars a year and 100 fakes cost 18,000 dollars a year: the total cost rises linearly with each added fake, while an honest user pays for only one line.
